record_scope_reconstruction: Nine separately scoped phases concern Bulgarian road approaches to Ruse/Giurgiu, Kardam/Negru Vodă, Vidin/Calafat and Durankulak/Vama Veche in March–April2023. Ruse roundabout is distinct from the Danube road/rail spans; Vidin action includes E79 at city entrance; Kardam is road, not parallel railway; Durankulak appears only for the diverted-truck phase. No all-border closure or multi-day continuous geometry is assumed.

source_checks.finding: Full migrated BNT article inspected: March29 short road blocks at Vidin international road to Bridge2 and Ruse/Kardam.
Full March29 report inspected: Ruse roundabout before bridge blocked.
Full March30 AGERPRES article quoting ITPF: both cars and trucks interrupted both directions in adjacent Ruse–Giurgiu area.
Full March30 Darik report inspected: E79 at Vidin entrance, queues both sides; short Ruse block also reported.
Full March31 BNT article inspected: sunflower dumped on road to Kardam, trucks stranded.
Full March31 Utro/BTA report inspected: Kardam outgoing trucks; Durankulak blocked previous day after diversions but no protesters there on publication day.
Direct 502, indexed April7 extract inspected: three-hour Kardam and Ruse road blocks; truck queue at Kardam.
Direct OSM topology inspected: Bulgarian approach roundabout road2 connects to Danube road bridge, separately from rail. XML sha256 7537628fab210c6f06e160b1f98bef3b7136a99c5fb8e71179980d23c1733eb3.
Direct OSM inspected; named Vama Veche customs is on Romanian side. No verified Bulgarian protest footprint extracted. XML sha256 3022d493dd44729f064577906bd1171f9724bc6151fdfe8a143154104b8d1900.
